world: A dense, remote tiger reserve forest in Central India (Madhya Pradesh) during the monsoon, from late afternoon into night, with wet deep-green foliage, damp mud, heavy mist, dim dusky light and cold desaturated blue-green tones.

characters.name: Aryan
characters.look: Indian man in his early 30s, lean athletic build, tired weathered face with stubble, short dark hair, wearing a mud-stained olive-green forest department uniform with a cap and boots, a rusted metal ID card clipped to his chest pocket.

characters.name: Vikram
characters.look: Indian man in his late 50s, stocky broad build, stern lined face with a thick grey moustache, short grey hair, wearing a faded khaki ranger uniform and a rain-darkened jacket, carrying a rifle and a walkie-talkie.

characters.name: Sudhansu
characters.look: Indian man in his 30s, neat short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a dark casual jacket, seated in a dim studio with warm amber light.
